description: Canonical schema for an IPO/FPO/rights issue event. Captures pricing, timeline, subscription, and listing performance. Root carries the standard metadata envelope (see properties) plus the canonical body sections; additionalProperties:false now covers the whole record.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this record conforms to.

design_notes: All monetary values stored as integer paise to avoid floating-point precision issues.
Subscription multiples stored as decimal strings to preserve precision.
Percentages stored as integer basis points (bps).
Dates stored as ISO 8601 strings with UTC offset.
Price band lower/upper stored as separate fields; issue_price_paise used for fixed price or cut-off.
Listing performance fields are optional as they may not be available for upcoming issues.
Documents section uses URLs; some sources may provide null values.
Category-wise subscription is an array to accommodate dynamic categories from NSE/BSE.
Locked at v2.0.0 on 2026-05-23. Future schema changes follow the deprecate-not-delete policy (FUTURE_PROOFING §1).
Added record-level field_provenance for multi-source attribution.
